---
# ocp4_workload_courier_routing: route optimiser and map tiles for the courier routing lab
- name: Create the courier routing namespace
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    api_version: v1
    kind: Namespace
    name: "courier-routing-{{ guid }}"
    state: present

- name: Create the map tile bucket
  amazon.aws.s3_bucket:
    name: "{{ courier_routing_bucket_name }}"
    region: "{{ aws_region }}"
    state: present

- name: Deploy the route optimiser
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    template: route-optimiser.yaml.j2

---
# ocp4_workload_courier_routing: route optimiser and map tiles for the courier routing lab
- name: Create the courier routing namespace
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    api_version: v1
    kind: Namespace
    name: "courier-routing-{{ guid }}"
    state: present

- name: Create the map tile bucket
  amazon.aws.s3_bucket:
    name: "{{ courier_routing_bucket_name }}"
    region: "{{ aws_region }}"
    state: present

- name: Deploy the route optimiser
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    template: route-optimiser.yaml.j2

---
# courier-routing-lab: last-mile route optimisation lab on OpenShift
cloud_provider: ec2
env_type: ocp4-cluster

__meta__:
  catalog:
    display_name: Courier Routing Lab
    category: Labs
  deployer:
    scm_url: https://github.com/agnosticd/agnosticd-v2.git
    scm_ref: main

workloads:
  - ocp4_workload_courier_routing

courier_routing_optimiser_replicas: 3
